objective: Audit candidate XBRL concepts and period contexts before creating canonical PIT fundamental features.
context_policy: Do not select a numeric fact by concept name alone.
For duration facts, preserve start_date/end_date and classify duration_days before quarter/YTD/annual use.
For instant facts, require instant date aligned to the reporting period.
Do not mix dimensioned segment/member facts into company-level canonical totals.
Prefer contexts with no dimensions for company-level canonical features unless a feature explicitly targets a dimension.
Keep standalone and consolidated mappings separate.
Bank/NBFC mappings may differ from corporate mappings; no forced global alias.
If multiple candidate facts remain after deterministic filters, mark AMBIGUOUS instead of guessing.
outputs: Per-document canonical candidate table with ambiguity status
